=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:351-368 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `mergeable=false` check compares a stale cached `tip` (read before the loop or at the previous iteration) with `pin`. If the base moves past the pin, the script returns `conflict not_mergeable` instead of merging locally into the pin.
  WHY: A head that merges cleanly into the pinned base can fail final CI as a conflict. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, the others MAJOR, so the highest (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:148 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh` inventory entry still says the script refreshes the merge ref "or fails the job". The script now merges locally into the pinned base (`outcome=merged_locally`).
  WHY: The inventory describes the opposite of the new behavior and omits the pin/local-merge contract.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:408 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "GitHub did not recompute ... after N attempt(s)" log line is also printed when the loop exits through the `mergeable=false` break past the pin.
  WHY: The wording contradicts the exit path actually taken. This was raised as a hardening suggestion by most reviewers and as a NIT finding by z-ai_glm-5_3-flash.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:240 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A runner git that rejects `merge-tree --attr-source` or `--no-messages` fails with the opaque `stale reason=merge_failed`.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell an unsupported git from a real merge failure. This was a hardening suggestion; the reviewers gave no severity.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: Update the documentation to reflect the new local-merge behavior; the README sections on CI triggers and the review/merge flow are updated in place, and the contributor-facing inventory must match.
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md:148 (entry for `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh`)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: docs/INVENTORY.md is not modified in this PR, and its entry still describes the pre-PR "or fails the job" behavior, which contradicts the new local merge into the pinned base.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh (refresh loop in ci_final_merge_ref_main, `mergeable=false` branch) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On the first attempt the cached `tip` is stale. A base move past the pin makes `mergeable=false` describe the newer base, and the script returns `conflict not_mergeable` without merging locally.
  WHY: A cleanly mergeable head can fail as a conflict. It is rare, because the base must move within a few seconds.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:148 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The entry says the script fails the job when the merge ref is stale. The script now merges locally into the pinned base.
  WHY: The inventory describes the opposite of the new behavior.
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh, the log line after the attempts loop. It still says all attempts ran without a recompute when the loop broke on `mergeable=false`. Suggested fix: set a flag in the break branch (about 3 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh, the `git merge-tree --attr-source` call in ci_final_merge_ref_merge_locally. An unsupported git yields an opaque `merge_failed`. Suggested fix: probe once and return `merge_tree_unsupported` (about 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:356 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `mergeable=false` check uses a stale `tip` read outside the refresh loop instead of re-reading the live tip.
  WHY: If the base advances before the recompute request, the script fails the job as a conflict instead of falling back to the local merge into the pin.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: Update the README sections on CI triggers and the review/merge flow in place.
  Expected change site: docs/INVENTORY.md
  Evidence of absence: The file is not modified in this PR, and the existing entry says the job fails if it cannot refresh the merge ref, which contradicts the new local-merge behavior.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:351-368 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cached `tip` set at line 327 is used in the `mergeable=false` check at line 358 without a re-read. A base move past the pin returns `conflict not_mergeable` even though the local merge into the pin would succeed.
  WHY: The window between line 327 and line 356 allows the race. The existing test `test_github_conflict_past_the_pin_defers_to_the_local_merge` does not exercise it, because its `true,false` sequence re-reads `tip` first.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: The PR description and `agents.d/9690-final-ci-local-merge.md` document the local merge into the pinned base. Any inventory of the script's behavior must reflect this.
  Expected change site: docs/INVENTORY.md:148
  Evidence of absence: The entry still describes the pre-PR behavior. No hunk in the PR diff touches `docs/INVENTORY.md`.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:240. `--attr-source` and `--no-messages` need a newer git, and older runners give an opaque `merge_failed`. Suggested fix: probe and return `merge_tree_unsupported` (about 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:408. The "after N attempt(s)" log line is misleading when the loop broke on the conflict-detection break at line 358. Suggested fix: set a flag in the break branch (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:356-367 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `mergeable=false` decision can use an outdated base tip. `tip` is read at line 327 and is not refreshed before the conflict return.
  WHY: The line 358 condition is false with the stale tip, so lines 364-367 return `conflict not_mergeable` without a local merge into the pin.
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:408. The message says "after ${attempts} attempt(s)" even when the loop exited early at line 362. Suggested fix: track the early break (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:355-368 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `mergeable` is read before `tip` is re-read. On attempt 1 `tip` is the pre-loop value, and later it is stale by a full sleep. A `mergeable=false` against a newer base is judged against the cached `tip == pin`, so the script returns `conflict not_mergeable`.
  WHY: A head that merges cleanly into the pinned base gets a red final-CI job. The PR's stated fix is incomplete.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:408 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "did not recompute ... after N attempt(s)" message is also printed when the loop exits via the `mergeable=false` break at line 362.
  WHY: The diagnostics are misleading for operators.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:148 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The inventory entry still says the script refreshes the merge ref "or fails the job". This PR changes the script to merge locally into the pinned base.
  WHY: The inventory describes the opposite of the shipped behavior and omits the pin/local-merge contract.
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:356-364. A `mergeable=false` answer is trusted without a fresher tip read. Suggested fix: re-read `tip` and append it to `seen_tips` before the check (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
